ideas.pitch: A RAG-powered multilingual voice and text platform using Granite LLM to deliver localized preventive health info and detect symptom outbreaks in semi-urban communities.
ideas.problem_statement: Real-world social challenges in Healthcare aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goal 3 (Good Health and Well-being).
ideas.title: ArogyaRAG: Multilingual Rural Health & Outbreak Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the explicit sponsor recommendation for Granite LLM and RAG while mirroring a proven first-prize architecture for social impact healthcare.

ideas.pitch: An agentic AI voice application that organizes neighborhood social outings with volunteer drivers while actively intercepting phone and email scams targeting elderly citizens.
ideas.problem_statement: Social inclusion, welfare, and community support challenges aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals.
ideas.title: SeniorLink: Multi-Agent AI Companion for Isolation & Scam Protection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages Agentic AI—a highlighted technology domain for the hackathon—and follows the grand-prize-winning blueprint of combining senior safety with automated community coordination.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and deep learning application that translates regional sign languages into spoken and text output for medical clinics and public service settings.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare accessibility challenges for marginalized populations aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals.
ideas.title: SignBridge AI: Real-Time Sign Language Triage for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents genuinely hard engineering through computer vision models, fulfilling the high-impact feasibility criteria judged in preliminary and final pitches.

ideas.pitch: An adaptive educational platform utilizing Generative AI to map traditional local work skills to emerging green economy jobs, generating personalized micro-learning paths.
ideas.problem_statement: Future of Work and Sustainability challenges aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth) and 13 (Climate Action).
ideas.title: EcoSkill: AI-Driven Upskilling & Green Job Transition Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Bridges two core hackathon domains—Sustainability and Future of Work—giving it broad appeal across multiple judging panels looking for clear, measurable economic transition metrics.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage tool featuring browser-based rPPG heart rate estimation and multi-language support to assist resource-constrained community health camps.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare delivery bottlenecks in resource-limited environments aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals.
ideas.title: MediScan Triage: Multilingual Vital Signs & Medical Triage Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a live-working prototype with quantifiable clinical utility, satisfying the crucial 'demo that actually worked live' winning pattern.
